# Floating-point operations and text

This module provides floating-point methods and conversions to strings.

## Model

Float methods combine arithmetic helpers with decimal conversion. Dragonbox, logarithm, and power data support the conversion and numerical kernels.

## Contracts

Generated tables remain intact in their own chunks. Precision-specific methods distinguish `f32` from `f64`. Numeric callers must account for IEEE special values.

## Executable example

```fern test name=std-f64-example
import "std/f64";

function main(): i32 {
  let value: f64 = 1.25;
  if (value.to_string() != "1.25") { return 1; }
  return 0;
}
```

### `3 function __float_int_part(n: f64): string`

```fern
<<3 function __float_int_part(n: f64): string>>=
function __float_int_part(n: f64): string {
  if (n < 1.0) {
    return "0";
  }
  let digits: string = "0123456789";
  let count: i32 = 0;
  let m: f64 = n;
  while (m >= 1.0) {
    m = __floor_f64(m / 10.0);
    count = count + 1;
  }
  let buf: u8[] = __alloc_u8(count);
  let pos: i32 = count - 1;
  while (n >= 1.0) {
    let q: f64 = __floor_f64(n / 10.0);
    let d: i32 = (n - q * 10.0) as i32;
    if (d < 0) {
      d = 0;
    }
    if (d > 9) {
      d = 9;
    }
    buf = buf.with(pos, digits[d] as u8);
    pos = pos - 1;
    n = q;
  }
  return string_from_bytes_unchecked(buf);
}
```

```fern
<<9 function __db_trim(d: (i64, i32)): (i64, i32)>>=
function __db_trim(d: (i64, i32)): (i64, i32) {
  let sig: i64 = d.0;
  if (sig % (10 as i64) != 0 as i64) {
    return d;
  }
  let exp: i32 = d.1;
  while (sig % (10 as i64) == 0 as i64) {
    sig = sig / (10 as i64);
    exp = exp + 1;
  }
  return (sig, exp);
}

function __float_to_string_prec(n: f64, prec: i32): string {
  if (n != n) {
    return "NaN";
  }
  let out: string = "";
  if (n < 0.0) {
    out = "-";
    n = 0.0 - n;
  }
  if (n != 0.0 && n * 2.0 == n) {
    return out + "Inf";
  }
  let mult: f64 = 1.0;
  let i: i32 = 0;
  while (i < prec) {
    mult = mult * 10.0;
    i = i + 1;
  }
  let scaled: f64 = __floor_f64(n * mult + 0.5);
  let intf: f64 = __floor_f64(scaled / mult);
  let fracf: f64 = scaled - intf * mult;
  out = out + __float_int_part(intf);
  if (prec == 0) {
    return out;
  }
  let fracStr: string = __float_int_part(fracf);
  while (fracStr.len() < prec) {
    fracStr = "0" + fracStr;
  }
  return out + "." + fracStr;
}
```

```fern
pub function (y: f64) atan2(x: f64): f64 {

  let pi_o_2: f64 = 1.5707963267948965580e+00;
  let pi: f64 = 3.1415926535897931160e+00;

    return x + y;

  let ix: i64 = hx & 0x7fffffff;
  let lx: i64 = _fd_lo(x);

  let ly: i64 = _fd_lo(y);
  if (hx == 0x3ff00000 && lx == 0) {
    return y.atan();
  }
  let m: i32 = 0;
  if (hy < 0) {
    m = m + 1;
  }
  if (hx < 0) {
    m = m + 2;
  }
  if ((iy | ly) == 0) {
    if (m < 2) {
      return y;
    }
    if (m == 2) {
      return pi;
    }
    return -pi;
  }
  if ((ix | lx) == 0) {
    if (hy < 0) {
      return -pi_o_2;
    }
    return pi_o_2;
  }
  if (ix == 0x7ff00000) {
    if (iy == 0x7ff00000) {

        return pi_o_4;
      }
      if (m == 1) {
        return -pi_o_4;
      }
      if (m == 2) {
        return 3.0 * pi_o_4;
      }
      return -3.0 * pi_o_4;
    }
    if (m == 0) {
      return 0.0;
    }
    if (m == 1) {
      return -0.0;
    }
    if (m == 2) {
      return pi;
    }
    return -pi;
  }
  if (iy == 0x7ff00000) {
    if (hy < 0) {
      return -pi_o_2;
    }
    return pi_o_2;
  }
  let k: i64 = iy - ix >> 20;
  let z: f64 = 0.0;
  if (k > 60) {
    z = pi_o_2 + 0.5 * pi_lo;
    m = m % 2;
  } else if (hx < 0 && k < -60) {
    z = 0.0;
  } else {
    z = __abs_f64(y / x).atan();

    return z;
```

```fern
pub function (x: f64) expm1(): f64 {

  let hx: i64 = b >> 32 & 0x7fffffff;

    if (hx >= 0x40862e42) {
      if (hx >= 0x7ff00000) {
        if ((hx & 0xfffff | _fd_lo(x)) != 0) {
          return x + x;
        }
        if (neg) {
          return -1.0;
        }
        return x;
      }
      if (x > 7.09782712893383973096e+02) {
        return 1.0e300 * 1.0e300;
      }
    }
    if (neg) {
      return -1.0;
    }
  }
  let k: i32 = 0;
  let c: f64 = 0.0;
  let v: f64 = x;
  if (hx > 0x3fd62e42) {
    let hi: f64 = 0.0;
    let lo: f64 = 0.0;
    if (hx < 0x3ff0a2b2) {
      if (!neg) {
        hi = x - ln2_hi;
        lo = ln2_lo;
        k = 1;
      } else {
        hi = x + ln2_hi;
        lo = -ln2_lo;
        k = -1;
      }
    } else {
      let half: f64 = 0.5;
      if (neg) {
        half = -0.5;
      }
      k = (invln2 * x + half) as i32;
      let t: f64 = k as f64;
      hi = x - t * ln2_hi;
      lo = t * ln2_lo;

    c = hi - v - lo;
  } else if (hx < 0x3c900000) {
    return x;
  }

  let hxs: f64 = v * hfx;
  let r1: f64 = 1.0 + hxs * (-3.33333333333331316428e-02 + hxs * (1.58730158725481460165e-03 + hxs * (-7.93650757867487942473e-05 + hxs * (4.00821782732936239552e-06 + hxs * -2.01099218183624371326e-07))));
  let t: f64 = 3.0 - r1 * hfx;
  let e: f64 = hxs * ((r1 - t) / (6.0 - v * t));

    return v - (v * e - hxs);

  e = v * (e - c) - c;
  e = e - hxs;
  if (k == -1) {
    return 0.5 * (v - e) - 0.5;

  if (k == 1) {
    if (v < -0.25) {
```

```fern
// fern-lint: allow cyclomatic-complexity
pub function (x: f64) log1p(): f64 {

      }

        return x;
      }
      return x - x * x * 0.5;

// sinh, cosh and tanh follow fdlibm's e_sinh.c, e_cosh.c and s_tanh.c.
pub function (x: f64) sinh(): f64 {
  let b: i64 = f64_bits(x);
  let ix: i64 = b >> 32 & 0x7fffffff;
  if (ix >= 0x7ff00000) {

  }

      return x;
    }
    let t: f64 = ax.expm1();
    if (ix < 0x3ff00000) {

pub function (x: f64) cosh(): f64 {
  let b: i64 = f64_bits(x);
  let ix: i64 = b >> 32 & 0x7fffffff;
  if (ix >= 0x7ff00000) {
    return x * x;
  }
  let ax: f64 = f64_from_bits(b & 0x7fffffffffffffff);
  if (ix < 0x3fd62e43) {

    let w: f64 = 1.0 + t;
    if (ix < 0x3c800000) {

    return 1.0 + t * t / (w + w);

    let t: f64 = ax.exp();
    return 0.5 * t + 0.5 / t;
  }
  if (ix < 0x40862e42) {
    return 0.5 * ax.exp();
  }
  if (_fd_hyp_finite(ix, x)) {
    let w: f64 = (0.5 * ax).exp();
    return 0.5 * w * w;
  }

// Whether |x|, with high word ix, is at most the largest argument for which
// sinh and cosh are finite.

pub function (x: f64) tanh(): f64 {
```

### `24 pub function (x: f64) hypot3(y: f64, z: f64): f64`

```fern
<<24 pub function (x: f64) hypot3(y: f64, z: f64): f64>>=
pub function (x: f64) hypot3(y: f64, z: f64): f64 {
  let ax: f64 = x.abs();
  let ay: f64 = y.abs();
  let az: f64 = z.abs();
  let hi: f64 = ax.max(ay).max(az);
  if (hi == 0.0) {
    return 0.0;
  }
  let rx: f64 = ax / hi;
  let ry: f64 = ay / hi;
  let rz: f64 = az / hi;
  return hi * (rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz).sqrt();
}
```

```fern
  return a * b + c;
}

pub function (x: f32) signum(): f32 {
  if (x != x) {
    return x;
  }
  if (x > 0.0 as f32) {
    return 1.0 as f32;
  }
  if (x < 0.0 as f32) {
    return 0.0 as f32 - 1.0 as f32;
  }
  return x;
}

pub function (a: f32) lerp(b: f32, t: f32): f32 {
  return a + (b - a) * t;
}

pub function (x: f32) recip(): f32 {
  return 1.0 as f32 / x;
}

pub function (x: f32) copysign(sign: f32): f32 {
  let m: f32 = x.abs();
  if (sign < 0.0 as f32) {
    return 0.0 as f32 - m;
  }
  return m;
}

pub function (a: f32) midpoint(b: f32): f32 {
  return (a as f64 * 0.5 + b as f64 * 0.5) as f32;
}

pub function (deg: f32) to_radians(): f32 {
  return (deg as f64 * (3.141592653589793 / 180.0)) as f32;
}

pub function (rad: f32) to_degrees(): f32 {
  return (rad as f64 * (180.0 / 3.141592653589793)) as f32;
}
```
